## Problem or use case
What concrete task should this resource help with?

## Proposed approach
What should it do, and how should it work?

## Target models or products
List intended compatibility. Mark anything untested as untested.

## Example
Provide a realistic example input and the behavior you would expect.

## Notes
Mention limitations, alternatives, and relevant licensing or attribution.
